learning_outcomes.text: Knows the mechanical spring types and is able to design springs.
Knows rolling-contact bearings types, performs calculations and selects from manufacturer's catalogues.
Defines lubrication conditions and is able to design journal bearings.
Knows gear types and basic concepts. Is able to design spur, helical, bevel and worm gears.
Defines and is able to design/select proper energy storing and/or transferring elements (couplings, clutches, brakes, flywheels and belts and ropes).
